scope: Identifiers/errors/needed redshifts and velocities only; no centre conversion, upstream imports or total covariance
inputs: Pinned V01 metadata and primary local code/config/data manifests
forbidden_columns: MM distance and all H0/alpha central values
permitted_outputs: Per-row input errors and simple variances; symbolic intercept and MM variance contracts
header_repair: Exact integral Decimal permits scientific notation in dimension header.
